study_metadata.title: Empirical Evaluation of LLM Quiz Generation Strategies in Educational Content

Full Context.notes: High question yield and wide coverage, but prone to surface-level recall questions (Remember level) and ungrounded distractors.

Retrieval.notes: Reduces context noise and eliminates completely ungrounded items, but boundary chunking reduces syllabus coverage and reasoning depth.

GenerateVerify.notes: Achieved 100% strongly grounded questions with zero hallucinations. Achieved highest cognitive-demand score of 1.250 by verifying Bloom's taxonomy criteria during verification pass. Slightly lower raw yield (72%) due to strict verification filtering.

confounding_factors.impact: Full Context strategy experienced a 15% reduction in grounding for facts located in the middle third of long documents.
confounding_factors.control_method: Document segment shuffling and position-balanced retrieval probes.

confounding_factors.impact: Retrieval chunks of fixed 500-token sizes occasionally bifurcated complex causal explanations, lowering multi-step reasoning yield.
confounding_factors.control_method: Semantic chunking with 150-token overlapping windows and hierarchical parent-document referencing.

confounding_factors.factor: Domain Familiarity & Prior Model Pretraining Bias
confounding_factors.impact: Higher correctness on canonical concepts (e.g., standard Mutexes) vs novel or niche domain specifications.
confounding_factors.control_method: Fictionalized synthetic educational modules and counterfactual premise testing.

confounding_factors.impact: Temperatures > 0.7 increased creative distractor plausibility but degraded grounding consistency.
confounding_factors.control_method: Fixed generation temperature (0.3 for Generation, 0.0 for Verification).

factors: Strategy (Full Context vs Retrieval vs GenerateVerify)
Domain Type (STEM vs Humanities vs Bio-Medical)
Cognitive Target Level (Bloom Recall vs Application vs Analysis)
proposed_followup_experiment.statistical_power: 0.85 power at alpha = 0.05 (detecting medium effect size d = 0.45)
proposed_followup_experiment.blinded_protocol: Double-blind evaluation where human domain experts and LLM raters receive randomized, anonymized question items
proposed_followup_experiment.inter_rater_reliability: Measured via Cohen's Quadratic Weighted Kappa (target kappa >= 0.82) and Fleiss' Kappa across multi-rater panels
measurable_evaluation_criteria: Strict Grounding Accuracy (Binary truth condition verified against source text span)
Distractor Discriminability (Point-biserial correlation in student pilot testing)
Cognitive Complexity Index (Bloom's Revised Taxonomy 1.00 to 1.50 scale)
Student Learning Gain (Normalized gain g = (post - pre) / (100 - pre))
